content.title: How the Narrative Surrounding Hasbro Is Changing as Gaming and Magic Drive the Next Chapter
content.summary: Hasbro's narrative is shifting as analysts lift their price targets, keeping fair value steady at $91.54 per share while nudging the discount rate from 7.61% to 7.68% to reflect a slightly higher required return. With long term revenue growth assumptions effectively unchanged at 5.25% annually, the move is being justified by renewed confidence in the durability of Magic: The Gathering demand and a strengthening video game roadmap that could support sustained earnings power. content.title: Trump needs to end the 'war on toys' from tariffs: Basic Fun! CEO
content.description:
Basic Fun! CEO Jay Foreman tells Yahoo Finance that President Trump has declared a "war on toys" this Christmas as the administration's tariff policies continue to pass costs onto US consumers and retailers. Foreman speaks to Julie Hyman about toy pricing trends and how the company is changing up their supply chain to account for tariff headwinds.

Also catch Jay Foreman explain how tariffs are directly raising their product prices.

Basic Fun! has licensing agreements to make and sell products from premier toy lines like My Little Pony, Hello Kitty, Tonka Trucks, Littlest Pet Shop, and Care Bears.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.

content.title: Toy prices will take on tariff costs this Christmas: Basic Fun! CEO
content.description:
With the kickoff to the holiday season just days away and plenty of retailers already offering Black Friday deals, Numerator reported 14.3% of American consumers expect to spend less on toys this holiday and 26.4% of respondents expecting to spend somewhat less.

Basic Fun! CEO Jay Foreman sits down with Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman to discuss the impact that 2025's tariff environment has had on the toymaker, its prices, and retail inventories.

Basic Fun! has licensing agreements to make and sell products from premier toy lines like My Little Pony, Hello Kitty, Tonka Trucks, Littlest Pet Shop, and Care Bears.
